In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] undertook a diplomatic '''mission''' to the planet [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] in order to escort the [[Venerated Ones]] of Vandelhelm, [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] and [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV]], back to their homeworld and obtain support of the Vandelhelm [[Metalsmiths Guild]] to the Alliance.<ref name="SW98" />
